en.title: FEES Schedule 8, 8.6: the consolidated text omits words adopted by Amendments No. 17
en.summary: Amendments No. 17 (13 November 2025) inserted 8.6 as "50% of an application fee for change of control payable under Schedule 1 of FEES". The consolidated V18 and the AFSA online rulebook omit "for change of control". The heading of 8.6 still ties the fee to change of control, so the meaning survives, but the published body text differs from the adopted one.
en.correction: Please align Schedule 8, paragraph 8.6 with Amendments No. 17 by restoring "for change of control".
